mapper.select: SELECT rs.id, rs.health_center_id, rs.service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, rs.slot_date, rs.start_time, rs.end_time, rs.capacity, rs.reserved_count, rs.active FROM reservation_slots rs INNER JOIN service_types st ON st.id = rs.service_type_id WHERE rs.service_type_id = #{serviceTypeId} AND rs.slot_date = #{date} AND rs.active = true AND st.active = true ORDER BY rs.start_time

SELECT rs.id, rs.health_center_id, rs.service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, rs.slot_date, rs.start_time, rs.end_time, rs.capacity, rs.reserved_count, rs.active FROM reservation_slots rs INNER JOIN service_types st ON st.id = rs.service_type_id WHERE rs.id = #{slotId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_slots ( health_center_id, service_type_id, slot_date, start_time, end_time, capacity, reserved_count, active, created_at ) VALUES ( #{healthCenterId}, #{serviceTypeId}, #{date}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{capacity}, 0, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
